parameters.query:
SELECT
  j.id as job_id,
  j.company, j.title, j.location, j.remote, j.url,
  j.match_score, j.technical_score, j.experience_score,
  j.strengths, j.missing_skills, j.salary,
  a.cover_note, a.custom_summary, a.id as application_id
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id
WHERE j.status = 'MATCHED'
  AND j.match_score >= {{ $env.MIN_MATCH_SCORE || 70 }}
  AND j.discovered_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours'
ORDER BY j.match_score DESC
LIMIT 15;

INSERT INTO pipeline_logs (source, job_id, operation, status, message)
VALUES ('telegram', '{{ $('Fetch New Matches').item.json.job_id }}'::uuid,
  'TELEGRAM_NOTIFICATION_SENT', 'SUCCESS',
  'Notification sent for {{ $('Fetch New Matches').item.json.company }} - {{ $('Fetch New Matches').item.json.title }}')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
